chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 275 – The Secret of Ji Ning’s Wings Is Exposed!
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Nine Lotos clash over politics; a puppet raid tries to steal the bronze lamp; Shaoyan Nong discovers Ji Ning’s secret link to the lost Yuchi clan.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 275 – The Secret of the Wings
og_description: A heist, a lovers’ quarrel, and a history-shattering discovery collide in the Wujiang Immortal Estate.
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s secret divine ability is spotted by a rival! The fallout is just beginning.

lore_anchors.definition: In Desolate Era, a being who has transcended the Three Realms and enjoys limitless lifespan; a single such immortal commands respect from entire ancient clans.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, a spiritually aligned ally for the long road to immortality.
A movement-type divine ability, a signature technique of the Yuchi clan; its discovery on Ji Ning is a major political red flag for the Shaoyan clan.
A prestigious but largely ceremonial title within the Grand Xia Dynasty, held by a branch leader of a major clan.
A type of combat automaton named after the mythical Qiongqi beast, often used in raids and battles in Xianxia stories.
A powerful Primal Fiendgod bodyguard of Shaoyan Nong; capable of manifesting clones from severed body parts.
The cosmic mechanism in the Netherworld Kingdom that cycles souls through six different realms of existence based on their karma.
